task_description: Write a method in Dafny to reverse only the vowels of a given string (where y is not a vowel).
specification_response:
method ReverseVowels(s: string) returns (v: string)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The output string contains the same characters as the input string, except that only the vowels are reversed in order
    - All non-vowel characters remain at their original positions
    - The relative order of non-vowel characters is unchanged
    - The set of vowels in the output string is the same as in the input string (same count and types)
